ca8bb0d81850cf.s: For renewable projects approved under the AP Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024, the land lease period is:
ca8bb0d81850cf.x: Land is leased for 30 years, with the lease amount rising by 5% every two years.

ca08d374324722.s: The Google Student Ambassador programme, for which Sai Pradeep was selected, trains campus ambassadors to promote:
ca08d374324722.x: The programme trains campus AI ambassadors to promote Google Gemini AI tools.

ca6ed1977c117f.s: The EIA Notification cited in the opposition to the Chelam Hill project is of the year:
ca6ed1977c117f.x: The EIA Notification 2006 was cited, along with Article 244(1), the Fifth Schedule, PESA 1996 and FRA 2006.

ca656da8a1da5c.s: The 360° Global Capability Centres Advisory Council of Andhra Pradesh was given a roadmap of how many years?
ca656da8a1da5c.x: The Council has a five-year roadmap, not three-year; IIT Tirupati and IIM Visakhapatnam are represented in it.

ca271983e59e65.s: Andhra Pradesh's smart ration cards cover approximately how many beneficiaries?
ca271983e59e65.x: The cards cover about 4.42 crore beneficiaries and work at any of the 29,000 fair price shops.

cafc024aa12f0d.s: Andhra Pradesh is targeting how much data-centre capacity by 2030?
cafc024aa12f0d.x: The State targets 6,000 MW of data-centre capacity by 2030, with Sify Infinity's 550 MW expansion an anchor project.

cac4b76896fe40.s: The National Green Hydrogen Mission targets how much green hydrogen production per year by 2030?
cac4b76896fe40.x: The Mission targets 5 MMT per year by 2030.

ca227d9c2a1f13.s: Commercial manufacturing at Sarla Aviation's Sky Factory is scheduled for:
ca227d9c2a1f13.x: Testing is scheduled for 2027 and commercial manufacturing for 2029.

cad06aa3f4b6e7.s: In the Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh, the wind-break component consists of:
cad06aa3f4b6e7.x: Wind breaks are canal-bund and roadside avenue plantations; mangroves and shelterbelts form the seaward edge and agroforestry the community buffer.

ca8b51badf06f8.s: The Swarna Naravaripalli project received the SKOCH Award for effective implementation of:
ca8b51badf06f8.x: The SKOCH Award recognised effective implementation of the PM Surya Ghar Scheme, not PM-KUSUM.

ne549ffa6401.s: Amaravati Quantum Valley, India's first under the National Quantum Mission, is based on technology from:
ne549ffa6401.x: It uses German technology, not Japanese, and its services begin in January 2027.

caa36b3b37ec4c.s: In the reclassification of gram panchayats in Andhra Pradesh, how many clusters were abolished?
caa36b3b37ec4c.x: 7,244 clusters were abolished; 13,351 is the number of independent panchayats created.

cae9841a0560f4.s: Andhra Pradesh's Circular Economy and Waste Recycling Policy (2025–30) envisages waste infrastructure that is:
cae9841a0560f4.x: The policy envisages dual-layered centralised and decentralised waste infrastructure; it also promotes industrial symbiosis.

ca6afb07d2e74e.s: Under IBM's Quantum Starling roadmap, linked to Amaravati Quantum Valley, a fault-tolerant quantum system is planned by:
ca6afb07d2e74e.x: IBM's Quantum Starling roadmap envisages logical-qubit computers and a fault-tolerant system by 2029.

cac689e3398ad6.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's sustainable tourism initiative, the Chief Minister directed the preparation of a Homestay:
cac689e3398ad6.x: The CM directed a Homestay Policy, not a Homestay Scheme; over 500 homestays were identified.

ca828eba80595c.s: In the Telangana–AP externally aided project debt dispute, Andhra Pradesh's share of ₹3,755 crore under the utilisation formula was:
ca828eba80595c.x: AP's share under the utilisation formula was ₹1,892 crore; ₹1,335 crore was what AP's own view assigned it for Krishnapatnam.

ca5ce1c0f53e54.s: Telangana favoured a population-based division of shared externally aided project debt under which provision of the AP Reorganisation Act?
ca5ce1c0f53e54.x: Telangana favoured a population-based split under Section 54(1) and claimed excess liability of about ₹1,449.75 crore.

ca90a22ee68592.s: The AP Cabinet approved a proposal to replace the words “new capital of residuary Andhra Pradesh” with “Amaravati” in the:
o: AP Capital Region Development Authority Act, 2014
ca90a22ee68592.x: The change is to the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, to give Amaravati statutory legitimacy as the capital.

caf28399bf2031.s: Through MGNREGA, the 'Adavi Thalli Baata' initiative brought an additional how many acres under coffee cultivation?
caf28399bf2031.x: An additional 1 lakh acres came under coffee, taking the total to 2.25 lakh acres.

cae2d450ef685f.s: Trinetra, an indigenous static firing and weapon testing facility, was commissioned at:
cae2d450ef685f.x: Trinetra was commissioned at Naval Station Bheemunipatnam to reduce dependence on foreign OEMs.

caf24ff4693404.s: The workshop held with the opening of the Data Science Centre at Tirupati marked which birth anniversary of C. R. Rao?
caf24ff4693404.x: The workshop marked C. R. Rao's 105th birth anniversary, not the 100th.

ca6a6164b0f6c2.s: On 1 May 2025, at Narempeta in SPSR Nellore, foundation stones were laid for how many MSME parks?
ca6a6164b0f6c2.x: Foundation stones were laid for 39 MSME parks, not 49.

ca1cfb3da2be35.s: The Amaravati capital housing plan provides for how many EWS families?
ca1cfb3da2be35.x: It provides for 5,000 EWS families, besides 3,500 apartments and 200 bungalows for officers.

ca0e8ffb0ef5d8.s: The APMB–APM Terminals pact is expected to generate nearly how many direct and indirect jobs?
ca0e8ffb0ef5d8.x: The pact is expected to generate nearly 10,000 direct and indirect jobs.

caf73eb1c34d95.s: Sarla Aviation's Sky Factory was announced at the CII Partnership Summit (14–15 November 2025) held in:
caf73eb1c34d95.x: It was announced at the CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam.

ca555021131fc6.s: Challa Chandrasekhar Reddy secured the first national position in the iGOT Karmayogi test with how many karma points?
ca555021131fc6.x: He ranked first nationally with 5,001 karma points, helped by bonus points for early completion.

ca54af77c764a3.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh AYUSH package, the two Ayurvedic college projects are at Dharmavaram and:
ca54af77c764a3.x: The two Ayurvedic colleges are at Dharmavaram (Sri Sathya Sai district) and Kakinada, with ₹70 crore each.

caf1e0ca363985.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 11th International Day of Yoga celebrations in Andhra Pradesh?
o: A Guinness World Record was set with 3 lakh participants at RK Beach, Visakhapatnam
The earlier record surpassed was Gujarat's 1.53 lakh participants in 2023
The Guinness certificate was presented to Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa
caf1e0ca363985.x: The Guinness certificate was presented to IT & HRD Minister Nara Lokesh.

cac663615a64f2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the impact of GST 2.0 on Andhra Pradesh?
o: PMAY completion in the State reached 40% in five years
The estimated annual loss to the State was ₹1,500–7,000 crore
AP GST collections rose 21% in August 2025 to ₹3,989 crore
SFURTI benefited 8,492 AP artisans in five years
cac663615a64f2.x: PMAY completion was only 35% in five years, not 40%.

cacd684304d6db.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Slum Level Federations honoured through MEPMA at the Swachha Andhra Awards 2025?
cacd684304d6db.x: Kurnool was not among the three honoured federations (Prakasam, Srikakulam and Visakhapatnam).

ca2eec6e0b080e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Indian Knowledge Systems Centre at National Sanskrit University, Tirupati?
o: Its focus includes political, economic and strategic sciences
Its texts include the Arthashastra, Dharmashastras and Mahabharata
Its areas include Ashwa-shastra and Gava-ayurveda
It is one of six IKS centres sanctioned across premier institutions
ca2eec6e0b080e.x: Eight IKS centres were sanctioned across premier institutions, not six.

caf0712df9fc54.s: Which of the following pairs of freedom fighters from Andhra Pradesh is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy – Armed uprising of 1857
Tanguturi Prakasam – First Chief Minister of Andhra State
caf0712df9fc54.x: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy led the armed uprising of 1846, not 1857.

ca1d07a4d19f71.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no dates to order)
ca1d07a4d19f71.s: Which freedom fighter from Andhra Pradesh took part in the Salt Satyagraha and later became an MP?
ca1d07a4d19f71.x: Sangam Lakshmi Bai took part in the Salt Satyagraha and later became an MP; Durgabai Deshmukh was a Constituent Assembly member and Pingali Venkayya designed the national flag.

ca5a046ffa6fc4.s: The Central Silk Board was established under the Ministry of Textiles in:
ca5a046ffa6fc4.x: The Central Silk Board was established in 1948 under the Ministry of Textiles.

caa35c446ce855.s: Erra Matti Dibbalu was one of how many Indian sites added to the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List?
caa35c446ce855.x: It was one of seven Indian sites added to the Tentative List; it is also one of India's 34 National Geo-heritage Sites.

caa4f7ae9492c5.s: The 17th-century Telugu inscription found in Prakasam district records a land grant for services to:
caa4f7ae9492c5.x: It records a grant of Ganupulapalli village and lands in Bomggaraputi for services to Lord Hanumanta.

ca2205dca4ed51.s: Aconcagua, the highest peak of South America, has a height of:
ca2205dca4ed51.x: Aconcagua is 6,961 metres high; 6,190 m is Denali, 5,642 m Elbrus and 8,848 m Everest.

ca54eb0219e948.s: Andhra Pradesh Tourism, winner of the Global Tourism Award 2025, signed how many MoUs in the preceding 15 months?
ca54eb0219e948.x: Andhra Pradesh signed 103 MoUs in the preceding 15 months.

caf47dd227f039.s: The Science Exposure Tour of East Godavari girls to Delhi included a visit to which planetarium?
caf47dd227f039.x: The itinerary included the Nehru Planetarium, the National Science Museum and the Russian Centre of Science and Culture.

caa397789ee461.s: The vocational training centre in Kakinada was set up by the Unnati Foundation along with:
caa397789ee461.x: It was set up by the Unnati Foundation with the AP State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC).

ca396916aaca50.s: MEPMA in Andhra Pradesh stands for:
o: Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas
Municipal Employment and Poverty Mitigation Agency
Mission for Empowerment of Poor in Municipal Areas
Municipal Engineering and Planning Management Authority
ca396916aaca50.x: MEPMA is the Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas, launched in 2007.

ca2a0ce0c47dca.s: The 3% sports quota notified in Andhra Pradesh is valid for how long, or until a new policy is introduced?
ca2a0ce0c47dca.x: The quota is valid for five years or until a new policy; it covers 65 sports, verified by SAAP.

cad847fefae388.s: Under GST 2.0, the GST rate on farm machinery changed from 12% to:
cad847fefae388.x: Farm machinery moved from 12% to 5%, not 18%.

caf08efe8ad409.s: Balaga Ganesh's English Channel crossing from England to France on 16 June 2024 was:
caf08efe8ad409.x: It was part of the six-member relay 'Pride of India – A Team'; his Palk Strait crossing was solo.

ca7f83fc6ee0ef.s: Mount Elbrus (5,642 m) lies in which mountain range?
ca7f83fc6ee0ef.x: Mount Elbrus lies in the Caucasus Range on the Russia–Georgia border; it is a dormant stratovolcano.

ca9d7bc84b0177.s: The Andhra Pradesh Group of Ministers to oversee and regulate social media platforms was formed on:
ca9d7bc84b0177.x: The GoM was formed on 2 October 2025; the central law in its terms of reference is the IT Act, 2000.

ca4910c53eb98c.s: In the case of Shabana, a trans woman, the Andhra Pradesh High Court upheld her right to invoke which provision?
ca4910c53eb98c.x: The Court upheld her right to invoke Section 498A, though the charges were quashed for lack of evidence.

cab3d08d0ffcfc.s: Telugu was recognised as a classical language in:
cab3d08d0ffcfc.x: Telugu was recognised as a classical language in 2008, not 2010.

ca8a54105baacc.s: In its ruling concerning a trans woman, the Andhra Pradesh High Court cited which Articles as the constitutional basis?
ca8a54105baacc.x: The constitutional basis cited comprised Articles 14, 15 and 21.

caa756d3b63e7c.s: The role of the Andhra Pradesh Group of Ministers formed to oversee social media is:
caa756d3b63e7c.x: The GoM only makes recommendations, such as suggesting nodal agencies or oversight bodies, and has no direct enforcement powers.

ca806732adb4af.s: Justice Subhendu Samanta, who assumed office as a judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court, was transferred from the:
ca806732adb4af.x: He was transferred from the Calcutta High Court; such transfers are made by the President under Article 222(1) after consulting the CJI.

ca3fe8ed806cc7.s: Which classical work was translated by the Centre of Excellence for Studies in Classical Telugu?
ca3fe8ed806cc7.x: The Centre translated “Kreedabhiramamu” and published Dr. Emani Sivanagireddy's “Mana Telugu Vari Sasanalu”.

ca2d36553fc65a.s: The Guru Brahma Award 2025 received by Siviku Bangarayya was presented by:
ca2d36553fc65a.x: The award was presented by All The Best Academy, Hyderabad, for his free coaching and study material to underprivileged students.

caf3f53471de4c.s: A Special Task Force to probe the March 2022 Jangareddygudem spurious liquor deaths was constituted on:
caf3f53471de4c.x: The STF was constituted on 20 May 2025 on the DGP's recommendation.

caad7324afea54.s: The Indian Knowledge Systems Centre at National Sanskrit University, Tirupati, comes under the IKS Division of the:
caad7324afea54.x: The centre is under the IKS Division of the Ministry of Education.

cad6b2181afae7.s: For completing 50 years as a lead hero, Nandamuri Balakrishna was included in which edition of the World Book of Records, U.K.?
cad6b2181afae7.x: He was included in the Gold Edition, not the Platinum Edition.

ca2d1a0f8f26b5.s: 'Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman' is a programme for:
ca2d1a0f8f26b5.x: Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman is a farmer-awareness programme, not one for SEZ exports.
